    visited[node] = True
    joke_set.add(jokes[node])
    
    # Check if the current set of jokes is consecutive
    if len(joke_set) > 1:
        min_joke = min(joke_set)
        max_joke = max(joke_set)
        expected_set = set(range(min_joke, max_joke + 1))
        if joke_set != expected_set:
            return
    
    # If we reach a leaf node, count this as a valid set

            dfs(neighbor, node, jokes, graph, visited, joke_set.copy(), valid_sets)
